I added `migrations/003_exports_status_default.sql`. I haven't run it.

It does three things, in order:
1. It sets `status = 'queued'` on existing `exports` rows where `status` is NULL.
2. It sets the column default to `'queued'`.
3. It sets the column to `NOT NULL`.

I left `001_init.sql` alone. Migrations apply in filename order, so a database that has already run 001 would never see an edit to it. The backfill has to come before `NOT NULL`, or the constraint would fail on the existing NULL rows.

I didn't check `src/exports/sink.ts`. If it explicitly inserts `null` for `status`, that insert will now fail instead of producing a NULL row, so it's worth a look.
